admin.paymentProvidersDescription: Configure payment gateways. Only one provider can be active at a time.
admin.robokassaTestModeHint: With test mode on, Robokassa requires the TEST Password #1/#2 pair. Live passwords + IsTest=1 cause error 29 (SignatureValue). For real payments, disable test mode and use live passwords.
admin.robokassaHashAlgorithmDescription: Must match the hash algorithm in Robokassa merchant technical settings (often MD5).
admin.robokassaFiscalizationDescription: Send Receipt JSON for 54-FZ. Enable only if fiscalization is configured in Robokassa — otherwise the signature must be computed without Receipt.
admin.robokassaPasswordHint: The field shows the masked stored password. To replace it, type a new value and leave the field.
admin.robokassaResultUrlDescription: Paste this exact URL into Robokassa → Technical settings → Result URL. It must use HTTPS (same as your site). Subscription activates only after Robokassa calls this URL — the Success URL redirect alone does not confirm payment. In test mode, use Password #1 and #2 from the «test payment» block in the Robokassa cabinet in Baserow.
admin.noPlans: No plans configured yet. Create your first plan.
admin.confirmDeletePlan: Delete this plan? This cannot be undone.
admin.deletePlanDisabledHint: This plan is assigned to one or more users. Reassign them first.

errors.cannotDeleteDefaultPlanDescription: Set another plan as default first, then you can delete this one.
errors.planHasSubscriptionsDescription: This plan is assigned to one or more users. Change their plan before deleting.
errors.planNotFoundDescription: The plan may have been removed already.

errors.planLimitExceededDescription: You have reached a limit of your current plan. Upgrade your plan to continue.
errors.limitCollaborators: Maximum number of collaborators in this workspace reached.
errors.limitStorage: Storage quota exceeded. Free up space or upgrade your plan.
errors.limitFileSize: This file exceeds the maximum upload size for your plan.
errors.limitApiCalls: Monthly API call quota exceeded. Try again next month or upgrade your plan.
